Alger, 24 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 24, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Optimum Telecom Algérie's subsidiary, "Djezzy Payment Services," has obtained approval from the Monetary and Banking Council to establish itself as a payment service provider. This decision aims to diversify transaction tools and support financial inclusion.
Feu vert de la Banque d'Algérie pour la: Green light from the Bank of Algeria for Optimum Telecom Algérie's subsidiary
Le Conseil monétaire et bancaire de la B: The Monetary and Banking Council of the Bank of Algeria, meeting in an ordinary session under the chairmanship of Governor Mohand Bouraï, has validated the establishment of "Djezzy Payment Services" as a Payment Service Provider (PSP). This entity is a subsidiary of Optimum Telecom Algérie.
Cette décision s'inscrit dans le cadre d: This decision is part of a precise regulatory process. Following this authorization of establishment, the company must submit an official approval request to the Bank of Algeria. This step must be finalized within a maximum period of twelve months from the date of notification of the decision.
Les prestataires de services de paiement: Payment service providers were introduced by Law 23-09 on the monetary and banking law. As new financial intermediaries, their mission consists of diversifying payment methods and actively participating in strengthening financial inclusion in the country.
Autorité de régulation : La décision a é: Regulatory authority: The decision was made by the Monetary and Banking Council of the Bank of Algeria, chaired by Mohand Bouraï.
Cadre d'application : L'autorisation est: Application framework: The authorization is governed by Regulation No. 25-02 setting the conditions for authorization, approval, and operation of PSPs.
Prochaine étape : Une demande d'agrément: Next step: An approval request must be filed with the Bank of Algeria within a maximum of twelve months after notification.
